title: Evidence
description: Test results written by `aidd test` in CI. Each result is bound to one head commit.

path.description: The JUnit XML report the command named, as a path in the repository.

tests.description: How many test cases the report lists.

failed.description: How many of them hold a failure or an error.

skipped.description: How many of them were skipped.

failed_tests.description: The first failed test cases, as `classname.name`.

problem.description: Why the report could not be read: missing, not written by this run, too large, or not a JUnit report. The counts are then absent. The exit code stays the evidence.

report.description: What the command's JUnit XML report says about this run.

aidd_commit.description: The aidd commit that ran the tests, from a checkout or a git install; a release has none.

head_sha.description: The commit the green results ran on.

base_sha.description: The merge base the red results ran on.

run_id.description: The CI run or job id.

url.description: The CI run or job's web address.

runner.description: Which CI run produced this file.

source.description: Where the command came from: the config's `tests` or the Spec's tests.commands.

runs_in.description: The folder the command ran in, when its `runs_in` named one.

related_tests.description: True when `aidd test --changed` ran the command's `related_tests.command`, which `command` shows: only the tests the runner relates to the change, so a pass says nothing of the full command. Only a `partial` run holds one.

exit.description: The exit code, or null when the command did not start or timed out.

duration_seconds.description: How long it ran, in seconds.

log.description: Its output log, relative to the evidence folder.

exit.description: This attempt's exit code, or null when it did not start or timed out.

duration_seconds.description: How long this attempt ran, in seconds.

log.description: This attempt's output log, relative to the evidence folder.

report.description: This attempt's JUnit XML report, when the command names one.

attempts.description: Every attempt, oldest first, when a green run was run again (`reruns`); the result's own fields are the last attempt's. A red run is never run again.

report.description: The command's JUnit XML report, when the command names one (`report`): the last attempt's.

flaky.description: True when a retry passed after a failure: the result counts green, and the flaky test is a finding to fix.

before_implement.description: True on a failing green result the runner expected before Implement. A command of the base commit's config is never excused.

results.description: One entry per command and red_green run. An empty list exits 1, unless the run is `partial` or `untested`.

specs.description: The Specs this run answered to, by path. `aidd status` shows the run beside each.

untested.description: True when no test command applies to the changed paths (all are limited by `when_changed`). Exit 0, but no proof.

specs_not_run.description: Open Specs whose scope the change touched without holding them, by path. Their tests did not run.

id.description: The Spec the change holds and revises, such as SPEC-1.

files.description: The files that Spec froze at the base and the change rewrites, sorted.

revised_frozen.description: Each Spec the change revises (a `revisions` entry the head wrote) whose frozen files it also changes, so the gate passed those changes with a note instead of stopping. A person reads the field, because the head wrote the entry, and approves each Spec again.

emergency_subset.description: True when a Spec the run answers to has the emergency route and the repository's `tests` ran as their `smoke` set alone, so a green `tests` check does not cover the rest of the suite. The base commit's config decides which commands are smoke. The route is the Spec's own text, which a head can write for a Spec new in it, so a person reads this field.

require_green.description: True for `aidd test --require-green`: no failing test is excused.

before_implement.description: True when a Spec before Implement held only its own files, so its failing run was expected. Each excused result says so.

partial.description: True when `aidd test --changed` ran only what the working-tree diff selects, so it never stands for the whole suite.

no_red.description: True for `aidd test --no-red`, which skips the red run.

tip.description: The target branch's tip commit, as the local ref `--base` named it.

changes.description: What changed between `base_sha` and the tip in what decides the run: the config's `tests`, `specs_dir`, and `docs_dir`, and the state of each Spec the run answers to.

target_moved.description: Set when the target changed what decides after the fork. The run used the fork's values.

dirty_tree.description: True when the tests ran in a tree that differs from the head commit (a dirty tree), so no result in it is evidence for that commit.

dirty_paths.description: The first of those paths, sorted, for the person who commits or stashes them.
